Search is splitting in two. We optimize for both.

Your customers used to type “roofer tampa” into Google. Now they’re typing “Who’s the best roofer for storm damage on flat roofs in Tampa?” into Claude.

AI now accounts for 56% of global search. AI Overviews have dropped organic CTR by 61% on the queries they appear in. And 43% of consumers trust what AI tells them about a brand, even with hallucinations on the table.

If your SEO strategy stops at Google rankings, you’re invisible to the channel that’s growing fastest.

Tired of agency reporting that hides more than it shows?

We were too. So we built the Youlytics portal.

It’s the most transparent reporting platform in agency work. Real-time, 24/7, every channel, every lead, every dollar. No filtered slides. No quarterly delays. No “the data’s still processing.” You see what we see, when we see it.

Every channel in one place

Google Ads, Meta Ads, paid search, organic, AI citations, CallRail, GA4. No tab-switching, no reconciling reports.

Full attribution down to the call

See which channel drove which lead, listen to the recording, and determine how long they stayed on the phone.
